$comment: Acceptance skips expected under CI (TF_ACC=1, WINDOWS_HOST set, but WITHOUT optional opt-in vars: WINDOWS_TEST_INTERFACE, WINDOWS_HOSTNAME_ALLOW_RENAME, WINDOWS_LP_MSI_URL/SHA256, WINDOWS_LP_EXE_URL/PATTERN, TF_ACC_TASK_USER/PASSWORD). Consumed by .github/scripts/Invoke-AccTests.ps1 (-AllowedSkipsFile): any SKIP whose test name matches no entry, or whose reason matches none of the entry's reason substrings, fails the lane. An entry with no 'reasons' key matches any reason for that test name. The list is global (no per-lane or per-workflow axis): both testacc-windows.yml and testacc-lab-container.yml enforce the same file. Future tightening: scope entries per lane/workflow once the suite grows skips that legitimately differ between the self-target runner and the lab container.

allowed.comment: Renaming the host is destructive and WINDOWS_HOSTNAME_ALLOW_RENAME is unset in CI, so the rename gate fires first; the SKELETON reason documents the second gate if renames were ever allowed.

DNS tests only touch an explicit secondary interface and refuse to run without WINDOWS_TEST_INTERFACE, which CI does not provide (covers TestAccWindowsDNSClient_Basic, _ResetOnDestroy and TestAccWindowsDNSClientDataSource_Basic, which has no underscore after Client).

reasons: not usable for a create-refusal assertion
allowed.comment: On a self-target runner (WINDOWS_HOST=127.0.0.1) the management address is loopback, which the plan validators reject before the guard runs, so the test skips instead of asserting the wrong diagnostic.

reasons: not usable for a refusal assertion
allowed.comment: Same self-target situation as the address guard: a loopback management next hop is rejected by the schema validators before the guard runs.

reasons: is the management interface; refusing to run address tests
allowed.comment: Self-target only: on testacc-windows (WINDOWS_HOST=127.0.0.1) the default test interface 'Loopback Pseudo-Interface 1' IS the management interface, so the suite refuses to touch it. The needle names this exact refusal; a skip with a different interface or reason still fails the gate (on the lab container these tests are expected to run).

reasons: is the management interface; refusing to run route tests
allowed.comment: Self-target only, same as the address tests: loopback is the management interface on testacc-windows.

Self-target only: on testacc-windows the SSH session arrives over loopback, which has no NetConnectionProfile, so the firewall tests cannot determine the session profile and skip. The needle names this exact loopback condition; on the lab container (real NIC) these tests run, and any skip there still fails the gate.
windows_winget_package resource suite is unimplemented (all nine TestAccWindowsWingetPackage_* tests skip immediately).
windows_winget_package data source suite is unimplemented (Basic, BasicDefaultSource, NotFound).
windows_environment_variable data source suite is unimplemented (Machine, User, ExpandTrue, NotFound).
The MSI fixture gate fires first in CI (no package URL configured); the SKELETON reason documents the second gate if fixture vars were ever provided.
windows_legacy_package lifecycle skeletons skip unconditionally (they have no env gate of their own).
The EXE fixture gate fires first in CI; the SKELETON reason documents the second gate if fixture vars were ever provided.
Implemented data source test, but its throwaway-MSI fixture needs WINDOWS_LP_MSI_URL/SHA256, which CI does not provide.
Needs a dedicated service account that CI does not provision.
Changing the system time zone is ineffective where the target shares the host clock (lab container): the mutability probe skips instead of failing. The InvalidIANA plan-time test never skips.

reasons: IIS management tools still missing after install
allowed.comment: The windows-latest GitHub image cannot provide the WebAdministration module (Install-WindowsFeature Web-Server/Web-Scripting-Tools/Web-Mgmt-Console reports success but the module never appears), so accEnsureIIS skips instead of failing. The needle names this exact post-install condition; on targets where IIS installs (lab servercore container), the tests run and any skip there still fails the gate.

Partition tests attach a throwaway VHDX via diskpart and require opt-in WINDOWS_ACC_STORAGE=1, which is unset in CI, so the skip is expected.
